parsed.name: 文件读写工具
parsed.description: 通用文件读写工具，用于实验软件中创建、选择、读取和写入数据文件。适合记录实验日志、保存测量结果，以及读取文本、CSV 和简单键值文本数据。
parsed.description_en: A general file I/O utility used in laboratory software to create, select, read, and write data files. It is suitable for experiment logging, saving measurement results, and reading text, CSV, and simple key-value text data.

actions.description: 在给定路径所在目录中创建文件。
actions.description_en: Create a file in the same directory as the given path.

actions.description: 初始化并追加写入指定名称的数据记录文件。
actions.description_en: Initialize and append to a data log file with the specified name.

actions.description: 读取 CSV 文件内容。
actions.description_en: Read the contents of a CSV file.

actions.description: 读取以空格分隔的文本并解析为键值数据。
actions.description_en: Read a space-delimited text file and parse it into key-value data.
Write text content to the file.
